mutants.name: the latch is computed after the live flags are overwritten, so it never records a release
mutants.find:
releasedAtParkRef.current = new Map(entries.filter((p) => p.collapsible && !p.live).map((p) => [p.id, parkReleases(p)]));
    liveBeforeRef.current = new Map(entries.map((p) => [p.id, p.live]));
mutants.replace:
liveBeforeRef.current = new Map(entries.map((p) => [p.id, p.live]));
    releasedAtParkRef.current = new Map(entries.filter((p) => p.collapsible && !p.live).map((p) => [p.id, parkReleases(p)]));
expectRed: a second render of the parked row before the retain timer fires still releases the value
